comments.author: Lumpy-Owl-7795
comments.body:
Here are the requirements:

1. You need to create a Signal group (you will need this to track performance) + you will need this to place trades too. (tell your agent and it will set this up for you).  
2. Now I use gpt 5 mini for chart reading and analysis and claude opus 5. You do not need an API key, you can use your subscription. But please use a small model e.g claude haiku for reading charts. Do not use Fable or opus for this as it's slow. Here is my configuration

AI\_MODEL=gpt-5-mini

AI\_METHOD=KEY

AI\_SUB\_MODEL=claude-opus-5

AI\_REFLECTION\_METHOD=SUB

  
the rest are blank.

gpt 5 min handles the analysis why claude handles the prompting, lessons and everything.
